body:
It was about 7:00 pm last saturday I had just read about the nutmeg and how it was meant to fuck one up..
Anyway me and jock (friend) who had
9 whole nutmegs. We grinded them all using a cheese grater. And then added the needed amount of water.
After an hour of boiling we were ready to get fucked for the night.  I downed mine in one but jordan had one sip and rejected the whole thing. So I had his aswell.  That night I felt nothing. I could see straight and pronounce proper words. That night just before I went to bed I thought what a load of bollox.
The next morning I woke up and....
My head was fucked. I looked in the mirror to see that my eyes were as red as red and I just burst out laughing. I couldnt walk straight and speaking was a real task. The only down thing about having nutmeg is waking up several times in the middle of the night craving for 20 minute shits and stomach ache. But other than that I looooved it and will definetly do it again.
